svg.title: Four-machine input transport and fighter ownership
svg.desc: Protocol 10 uses three UDP links to P1. Guests send only their own machine input blocks; P1 forwards the others. Separate input histories feed rollback on every machine. Controls use 16-bit words. The input ring holds 128 frames per machine, 16 snapshots are kept, and prediction is capped at 8 frames. ReadPanel at 0x01368E resolves the fighter owner through tag::Person and reads tag::Held. The history illustration is schematic, not a measured trace. Code and gameplay evidence are tied to 471f7f7.

g.aria-label: Protocol 10 carries four owners into the same rollback simulation.
